content.short: Chronicle Protocol offers scalable, cryptographically verifiable oracle solutions for DeFi, originally developed to power MakerDAO and Spark.
content.description: Chronicle Protocol is a next-generation oracle network providing cryptographically verifiable price feeds where each price update is signed by a network of validators, enabling on-chain verification of data integrity. Originally developed for MakerDAO  one of DeFi's oldest protocols  Chronicle uses an architecture that is significantly more gas-efficient than traditional oracle designs. Deployed on Mantle, Chronicle provides verifiable, cost-efficient oracle data to the network's DeFi ecosystem.
